caseName: United States ex rel. Schirrmeister v. Watkins
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Schirrmeister v. Watkins, District Director, Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: P. Bateman Ennis for petitioner., Solicitor General Perlman for respondent.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is denied for the reason that application therefor was not made within the time provided by law. 28 U. S. C. § 2101 (c).
